item_aether_lens.desc: +225 cast range for your hero spells.
item_aether_lens.title: Aether Lens

item_arcane_boots.desc: Use to restore 150 mana to allies within 1200. Allies nearby regenerate 1 extra mana per second.

item_assault.desc: Allies and buildings within 1200 gain 30 attack speed and 5 armor; enemies there lose 5 armor.

item_basher.desc: Attacks have a 25% chance (10% ranged) to stun for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 extra damage. Once per 2.3 seconds.

item_bfury.desc: Melee attacks cleave 60% damage (40% to creeps) in a cone behind the target. +10 damage against non-heroes. Use on a tree to cut it.

item_blight_stone.desc: Attacks strip 2 armor from the target for 3 seconds.

item_branches.desc: A cheap twig with a little of every attribute.

item_chasm_stone.desc: Component of Shiva's Guard. Its area bonus is not modelled in this map.

item_clarity.desc: Regenerates 6 mana per second for 25 seconds. Damage from an enemy hero ends it.
item_clarity.title: Clarity

item_cloak.desc: Shrugs off part of all magic damage.
item_cloak.title: Cloak

item_cyclone.desc: Use on an enemy or yourself: the target is lifted for 2.5 seconds and can neither act nor be hurt. Enemies take 50 magic damage on landing.

item_dagon.desc: Use to blast an enemy for 400 magic damage.

item_desolator.desc: Attacks strip 6 armor for 7 seconds. Gains 2 damage per hero kill, up to 30.
item_desolator.title: Desolator

item_dust.desc: Exposes and slows (20%) invisible enemy heroes within 1050 of where you stand for 12 seconds.

item_enchanted_mango.desc: Use to restore 100 mana at once.
item_enchanted_mango.title: Enchanted Mango

item_faerie_fire.desc: Use to heal 85 health at once.
item_faerie_fire.title: Faerie Fire

item_flask.desc: Regenerates 30 health per second for 13 seconds (half on an ally). Damage from an enemy hero ends it.

item_force_staff.desc: Use to shove any unit 600 units in the direction it faces.
item_force_staff.title: Force Staff

item_greater_crit.desc: Attacks have a 30% chance to hit for 225% damage.
item_greater_crit.title: Daedalus

item_hand_of_midas.desc: Use on a non-hero, non-ancient enemy to turn it into 160 gold. Holds up to 2 charges; one returns every 90 seconds.
item_hand_of_midas.title: Hand of Midas

item_headdress.desc: Allies within 1200 regenerate 2 extra health per second.
item_headdress.title: Headdress

item_heart.desc: Regenerates 1% of maximum health plus 1.5% of missing health every second.
item_heart.title: Heart of Tarrasque

item_javelin.desc: Attacks have a 25% chance to deal 60 extra magic damage and cannot be evaded when that happens.
item_javelin.title: Javelin

item_kaya.desc: 10% more spell damage and 20% stronger mana regeneration.
item_kaya.title: Kaya

item_lesser_crit.desc: Attacks have a 30% chance to hit for 160% damage.
item_lesser_crit.title: Crystalys

item_lifesteal.desc: Attacks heal you for part of the damage they deal.
item_lifesteal.title: Morbid Mask

item_magic_stick.desc: Gains a charge (up to 10) when a visible enemy hero within 1200 casts a spell. Use to restore 15 health and mana per charge.
item_magic_stick.title: Magic Stick

item_magic_wand.desc: Gains a charge (up to 20) when a visible enemy hero within 1200 casts a spell. Use to restore 15 health and mana per charge.
item_magic_wand.title: Magic Wand

item_manta.desc: Use to split into 2 illusions for 18 seconds and drop most debuffs. Illusions deal 33% damage (25% ranged) and take 300% damage.
item_manta.title: Manta Style

item_mekansm.desc: Use to heal allied units within 1200 for 250. Allies nearby regenerate 2.5 extra health per second.
item_mekansm.title: Mekansm

item_monkey_king_bar.desc: Attacks have an 80% chance to deal 70 extra magic damage and cannot be evaded when that happens.
item_monkey_king_bar.title: Monkey King Bar

item_phase_boots.desc: Use for 20% more speed (10% ranged) and to walk through units for 3 seconds. Pairs of boots do not add up.
item_phase_boots.title: Phase Boots

item_power_treads.desc: Use to move the +10 attribute between Strength, Intelligence and Agility. Pairs of boots do not add up.
item_power_treads.title: Power Treads

item_quelling_blade.desc: +8 attack damage against non-hero units (4 for ranged heroes). Use on a tree to cut it down.
item_quelling_blade.title: Quelling Blade

item_radiance.desc: Burns enemies within 650 for 60 magic damage per second (always on).
item_radiance.title: Radiance

item_refresher.desc: Use to reset the cooldowns of your hero abilities. Items keep their cooldowns.
item_refresher.title: Refresher Orb

item_ring_of_basilius.desc: Allies within 1200 regenerate 1 extra mana per second.
item_ring_of_basilius.title: Ring of Basilius

item_sange_and_yasha.desc: Strength, agility, attack speed, 12% movement speed and 16% stronger health regeneration.
item_sange_and_yasha.title: Sange and Yasha

item_satanic.desc: Use to raise lifesteal to 175% for 6 seconds and drop most debuffs.
item_satanic.title: Satanic

item_sheepstick.desc: Use to turn an enemy into a harmless critter for 2.8 seconds.
item_sheepstick.title: Scythe of Vyse

item_shivas_guard.desc: Use to send out a frost wave (825 radius) that deals 225 magic damage and slows by 40% for 4 seconds. Enemies within 1200 lose 40 attack speed.
item_shivas_guard.title: Shiva's Guard

item_talisman_of_evasion.desc: Gives a chance to dodge attacks.
item_talisman_of_evasion.title: Talisman of Evasion

item_tango.desc: Eat a tree to regenerate 7 health per second for 16 seconds.
item_tango.title: Tango

item_tpscroll.desc: Channel for 3 seconds, then teleport next to the friendly building nearest to the target point.
item_tpscroll.title: Town Portal Scroll

item_ward_observer.desc: Plants an invisible ward that watches a 1600 radius for 360 seconds.
item_ward_observer.title: Observer Ward

item_ward_sentry.desc: Plants an invisible ward that exposes invisible enemies within 1050 for 420 seconds. It gives no vision by itself.
item_ward_sentry.title: Sentry Ward

item_wind_lace.desc: Light shoes that stack with boots but not with Eul's Scepter.
item_wind_lace.title: Wind Lace

item_yasha.desc: Agility, attack speed and 10% movement speed (Yasha items do not add up).
item_yasha.title: Yasha

notes.patch: All 78 requested items exist in the installed patch. Recipes follow it: Arcane Boots use Ring of Basilius + Wizard Hat, Shiva's Guard uses Splintmail + Chasm Stone, Refresher Orb uses Ring of Tarrasque + Tiara of Selemene, Manta uses Diadem, Dagon uses Crown + Wizard Hat. Their components are sold too.
notes.simplified: Radiance burns permanently (no toggle). BKB gives full magic immunity (the patch gives 60% magic resistance plus debuff immunity). Status resistance, slow resistance, Chasm Stone area bonus, Monkey King Bar melee range and Iron Branch tree planting are not modelled.
notes.storage: As in Dota: 6 main slots, a 3-slot backpack, a 6-slot stash, the TP scroll slot and a courier per player (src/game/inventory.lua, courier.lua). Secret items are sold only at the Secret Shops (mapdata.side_shops).
